text:
ashley: Quick check — PR #3921 is ready to merge if nobody objects. Mostly formatting + a tiny rename (RequestID -> requestId) and a proto tag reorder. CI is green except one flaky unit test that previously flaked and looks unrelated. planning to land in the 4pm PST merge window unless someone raises an issue. :clock4:

jon: thanks — can you paste the import reorder? want to make sure it didn't change semantics for the grpc wrapper.

ashley: sure — diff snippet:```diff
- import (
-     "context"
-     "google.golang.org/grpc"
- )
+ import (
+     "context"
+     "encoding/json"
+     grpc "google.golang.org/grpc"
+ )
```
It just grouped stdlib vs third-party and aliased grpc to avoid shadowing a local var. No behavior change.

priya: quick nit — we prefer camelCase for proto json names, did you update the generated JSON tags or leave them? if you left them the same it's fine but callout in the PR description would help.

ashley: left the generated tags alone. Added a note in the PR description now. Also ran `gofmt` and `gofumpt`.

kevin: CI bot shows an import-order lint warning in one file still. small: run `goimports -w` on `service/handler.go` and rebump.

ashley: ack, will run and push a tiny fix.

ci-bot: build #12234 passed · unit-tests flaky: test_cache_eviction (re-run recommended)

jon: if test_cache_eviction is known flaky, go ahead and merge once ashley pushes the goimports fix and we have one more approval. priya, can you give the final approve? :eyes:

priya: watching now, give me a minute.

ashley: pushed goimports fix (force-pushed small rebase). hope that's okay — only whitespace/imports changed.

priya: looks good to me, LGTM. :thumbsup:

kevin: non-blocking: consider adding a short changelog note about the RequestID rename for downstream callers (api changelog).

ashley: will add a one-liner to CHANGELOG under "unreleased" after merge. thanks.

jon: cool — with priya approving and CI green, go ahead and land in 4pm window. try to squash the import fix into the original commit if it keeps history tidy.

ashley: will squash and merge at ~16:02 PST unless anything pops up. thanks all. :sparkles:
